name: video-rename
description: Rename videos to YYYY-MM-DD__descriptive_slug.ext from a Claude vision read of sampled frames (optional Whisper transcript via tools/transcription): `analyze` is a paid read that only proposes, `rename` needs --yes, every rename is logged and `undo` reverses it
hits: local video files + the Anthropic API (paid, the operator's own key)
surface: CLI. `analyze` samples frames, asks Claude, prints the plan and saves it (paid; audit line per call; --explain estimates cost with no call). `rename` previews by default and renames only with --yes — or replays a saved plan with `--plan FILE --yes` at no API cost; never overwrites; audit line per rename. Every rename lands in renames.jsonl and `undo --yes` reverses it. In-code ceilings on frames (16) and files per run (25 default, 200 max).

origin.note: vendored as tools/video-rename; the Python package keeps its upstream name video_analysis. The belt added the verb split (analyze/rename/undo/log), the --yes gate, the plan files, the audit and rename logs, the key-file resolution, the ceilings, and the belt-first lookup of `transcribe`

install.description: Create the in-project .venv on Homebrew Python 3.13 and install the locked dependencies (PyAV, anthropic, pillow, typer, rich)
install.why: poetry.toml pins the venv in-project so the path is stable and nothing is installed globally; PyAV needs Homebrew ffmpeg 8.x at runtime
install.yes: .venv/ is created inside tools/video-rename from poetry.lock; no network call to Anthropic is made
install.no: skipped; every `poetry run video-rename` fails on import until you run it

install.description: Create the directory the key file lives in (~/.config/toolbelt/video-rename.env, mode 600)
install.why: the key belongs outside the tree; the tool refuses a group/world-readable key file
install.yes: mkdir -p ~/.config/toolbelt; you still write the file yourself
install.no: export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the shell instead

env.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.description: The operator's own Anthropic API key. Alternative: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=... in ~/.config/toolbelt/video-rename.env (mode 600). Only `analyze` and a `rename` without --plan need it; --explain, --plan, undo and log do not

env.name: VIDEO_RENAME_HOME
env.description: Where audit.log, renames.jsonl and plans/ live. Default ~/.local/share/video-rename (dir 700, files 600). Tests point it at a temp dir

env.name: TOOLBELT
env.description: Belt root used to find tools/transcription/.venv/bin/transcribe; defaults to the root this tool sits in

auth.flow: the operator's own Anthropic API key from $ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, else a 600-mode dotenv file; billed to the operator's account
auth.login: Create a key at console.anthropic.com, then: printf 'ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-...\n' > ~/.config/toolbelt/video-rename.env && chmod 600 ~/.config/toolbelt/video-rename.env
auth.identity: poetry run video-rename analyze tests/fixtures/tiny.mp4 --explain   (prints which key source is in use, never the key)

caches.note: optional 600-mode dotenv file; a group/world-readable file is refused. An in-tree .env is read as a deprecated fallback and named on stderr

safeguards: Read-first: `analyze` never renames — it proposes, prints, and saves a plan; the rename code path is a separate verb (cli.py rename) (SENSIBILITIES #1)

`rename` without --yes writes nothing: it prints the plan and the exact `rename --plan <file> --yes` re-run; --yes is the loud, always-honored flag for a private, reversible write (cli.py rename; SENSIBILITIES #2 flag tier)

Every rename stays in place and is reversible: rename.check_same_directory refuses a destination outside the source's resolved directory (so a hand-edited plan or log cannot move a file), rename.apply_rename never overwrites (FileExistsError), the new name is collision-safe (build_new_name probes _2, _3 …), and each rename is appended to renames.jsonl so `undo --yes` puts it back (paths.record_rename, cli.py undo)
Read back after every write: the rename returns, then the filesystem is re-checked and RE-READ MISMATCH is reported if the destination is missing or the source remains (cli.py _apply_entries)

Audit line to stderr and to ~/.local/share/video-rename/audit.log on every paid call (model, frames, tokens the API reported) and every rename/undo (old → new) — never the key, never a frame (paths.audit; SENSIBILITIES #7)

Ceilings are code constants in config.py: MAX_FRAMES=16 and MAX_FILES=200 are refused above, not lowered; DEFAULT_MAX_FILES=25 guards a recursive sweep, --max-files raises it up to the ceiling (cli.py _settings/_discover; SENSIBILITIES #3)
--explain pre-flight on analyze and rename lists the files, model, frame count and an approximate input cost and makes no API call — it needs no key (cli.py _explain; SENSIBILITIES #5)
Degraded mode is named: a missing `transcribe` binary prints one yellow line and the run continues visual-only; one failed transcription affects only that file (cli.py _analyze; SENSIBILITIES #8)

Key from $ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or ~/.config/toolbelt/video-rename.env only; a group/world-readable key file is refused; the in-tree .env fallback is announced as deprecated; the key is passed to the SDK in-process and never printed, logged, or placed on argv (auth.py; SENSIBILITIES #6, #11)
Files that already match YYYY-MM-DD__ are skipped unless --include-renamed, so a re-run over a sorted folder spends nothing (discover.looks_renamed)
The VERBS table in cli.py is the tier contract; tests/test_safety.py asserts the manifest's verbs[] matches it

verbs.name: analyze
verbs.note: paid: one Claude vision call per file (sonnet default, ~$0.003–0.01/file at medium res); proposes names only; audit line per call; --explain is free

verbs.name: rename
verbs.note: preview by default (a paid analyze + a saved plan); --yes renames; `--plan FILE --yes` replays a saved plan with no API call; renames only inside the file's own directory, never overwrites, each one logged for undo

verbs.name: undo
verbs.note: preview by default; --yes renames the last N files back from renames.jsonl; refuses when the target now exists

verbs.name: log
verbs.note: the rename log; --all includes undone renames

verbs.name: delete / move across directories / overwrite
verbs.note: no code path: rename.check_same_directory (enforced in apply_rename, _apply_entries and undo) refuses any destination outside the source's resolved directory, and an existing target is refused

risk.worst_case: a batch of the operator's own video files renamed to names a model chose — every one logged and reversible with `undo`, and up to 200 paid vision calls on the operator's own Anthropic account (≈ a few dollars at the default model and resolution)

checks.fix: brew install ffmpeg — PyAV links against Homebrew ffmpeg 8.x at runtime

checks.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
checks.label: Anthropic API key present (env, or ~/.config/toolbelt/video-rename.env mode 600)
transcribe CLI reachable (tools/transcription/.venv, then PATH) — optional, --transcribe degrades without it

smoke_test.command: poetry run video-rename --help >/dev/null && VIDEO_RENAME_HOME=$(mktemp -d) poetry run video-rename analyze tests/fixtures/tiny.mp4 --explain && VIDEO_RENAME_HOME=$(mktemp -d) poetry run pytest -q
smoke_test.expect: help renders; the --explain pre-flight lists the fixture, model and cost estimate with no API call and no key; pytest green (frame extraction against the fixture, naming, key resolution, audit/rename log, undo, ceilings, manifest↔VERBS parity) — no network, nothing outside a temp dir touched
